summary: Ten Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) for OxiGuitar covering project governance, core architecture, and platform-specific decisions. ADR 0000 provides the template; ADR 0001 establishes the ADR recording process. ADR 0002 defines the score model (tree-based, alphaTab-like). ADR 0003 decides on writing custom file readers instead of adopting the guitarpro crate. ADR 0004 selects Slint as the GUI toolkit over iced and egui. ADR 0005 chooses CPU raster rendering via tiny-skia with krilla for PDF export. ADR 0006 accepts no file-drop support on Wayland as a permanent gap. ADR 0007 accepts no macOS open-document events as a permanent gap. ADR 0008 introduces a plugin architecture with native libraries, splitting milestones. ADR 0009 enforces a Wayland-first policy by pinning Slint to 1.17.1 to avoid X11 dependencies in the Wayland build. The ADRs reference several non-ADR project files: ARCHITECTURE.md, ROADMAP.md, docs/design/ui.md, docs/design/plugins.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and the GUI spike at spikes/gui/.

nodes.label: ADR 0000 — Template
nodes.description: Template for Architecture Decision Records with sections for Context, Options, Decision, and Consequences.

nodes.label: ADR 0001 — Record decisions in the repository
nodes.description: Establishes the ADR process: every significant decision gets a numbered record in docs/adr/, never rewritten after acceptance, later records supersede earlier ones. References the project brief and ROADMAP.md.

nodes.label: ADR 0002 — Score model, first version
nodes.description: Decides on a tree-based score model (alphaTab-like) with Score > MasterBar > Track > Staff > Bar > Voice > Beat > Note. Defines exact time via Duration with tuplets, grace notes as time-free beats, fretted/pitched notes, bends, and effects. Readers map GP3–5, GPX, GP7/8, MuseScore, and MusicXML onto this model.

nodes.label: ADR 0003 — File readers: write our own, cross-check with guitarpro
nodes.description: Decides to write custom file readers (oxiguitar-formats) instead of adopting or forking the guitarpro crate. Readers are written for untrusted input with bounds-checked reads. guitarpro is kept as a cross-check tool. Plans GPX and GP7/8 readers next.

nodes.label: ADR 0004 — GUI toolkit: Slint
nodes.description: Selects Slint over iced and egui as the GUI toolkit. Scores include palette/docking, keyboard/screen-reader access, text input, API stability, and mobile path. Slint wins on accessibility, i18n, API stability, and mobile. egui is the fallback. References the renderer ADR and UI design doc.

nodes.label: ADR 0005 — Renderer: CPU raster + krilla PDF
nodes.description: Chooses CPU raster rendering via tiny-skia for screen, PNG export, and visual regression tests, with krilla for PDF export. Both backends draw from the same oxiguitar-display list. Bravura music font with Noto Sans text font. Plans tiling for smooth scrolling.

nodes.label: ADR 0006 — No file drops on Wayland
nodes.description: Accepts no file-drop support on Wayland as a permanent gap. winit 0.30 has no Wayland drag-and-drop; Slint 1.18 doesn't forward OS drops. Rejects unsafe workarounds and polling. Users open files via File → Open, double-click in file manager, or command line.

nodes.label: ADR 0007 — No macOS open document events
nodes.description: Accepts no macOS open-document events (Apple Events) as a permanent gap. winit 0.30 has no event for opened documents; Slint 1.18 forwards none. Rejects unsafe NSApplicationDelegate workaround. Users open files via File → Open, dock drops, or command line.

nodes.label: ADR 0008 — Plugin architecture
nodes.description: Introduces a plugin system with native .oxp libraries, one per format/tool/platform. Core keeps model, editing, engraving, player transport, mixer, settings, and plugin host. Plugins for formats, exports, audio, and platform code. Moves plugin system from M5 to M2. Contains multiple amendments from Mateus. References docs/design/plugins.md.

nodes.label: ADR 0009 — Wayland first: Slint pinned to 1.17.1
nodes.description: Enforces Wayland-first policy: pins Slint to 1.17.1 to avoid arboard's X11 dependency in the Wayland build. Slint 1.18 replaced copypasta with arboard which always pulls x11rb. Sets rule that Wayland build gets the clean solution; X11 build gets workarounds. References ADR 0008 for the two-build plan.
